## H1: Local SEO for Doctors in Chandigarh — Get More Patient Appointments from Google

If you run a clinic, dental practice, dermatology centre, IVF centre or gynaecology practice in Chandigarh, your next patients are already searching for you on Google. The question is whether they find you — or your competitor two blocks away.

**Local SEO is what puts your clinic in the Google Maps 3-pack** — the box at the top of every local search showing the top 3 businesses near the searcher. When a Chandigarh resident searches "dentist near me" or "dermatologist Sector 22", the 3-pack is the first thing they see. If you're not in it, you're invisible.

This page is a straight-shooting guide to what local SEO for doctors in Chandigarh actually means, what it costs, and how Prime Bridge Media runs it.

## What is local SEO for doctors (in plain English)?

Local SEO is the work of making your clinic show up when someone near your practice searches Google for the service you offer. There are four levers:

1. **Google Business Profile (GMB)** — your free Google listing. Most Chandigarh clinics have one but it's half-filled, which actively hurts rankings.
2. **On-page SEO** — your website's wording, structure and schema so Google understands exactly what you do, where, and for whom.
3. **Reviews and ratings** — both quantity and recency. A clinic with 80 reviews beats a clinic with 12, every time.
4. **Citations** — your clinic's Name, Address, Phone (NAP) listed consistently across Justdial, Sulekha, Practo, IndiaMART, and 30+ other directories.

When all four are tuned, your clinic lands in the Maps 3-pack for searches like "dentist Sector 22 Chandigarh" or "skin specialist near Sukhna Lake".

## Why most Chandigarh clinics lose patients to competitors

We audit 5-10 clinics a month in Tricity. The pattern is the same:

| Issue | How many clinics have it | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| GMB listing unclaimed or half-filled | ~70% | Invisible on Maps |
| Inconsistent NAP across directories | ~60% | Confuses Google, drops ranking |
| Less than 20 Google reviews | ~75% | Loses 3-pack to better-reviewed competitors |
| No schema markup on website | ~90% | Google can't read your services |
| Website slower than 3 seconds on mobile | ~80% | Searchers leave, ranking drops |

You don't need to fix all of these. You need to fix the top 2-3 that are losing you the most patients. That's what we do.
